Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking the SIG onboarding. FinServe's security team is reviewing vendor submissions and we need a concise vulnerability management packet for our assessment. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday?

- Confirmation of scan cadence (internal schedule + external/third-party scans)
- CVE remediation SLAs by severity and exception policy
- Evidence of last three monthly scans (summary CSV is fine) and a representative closure log for a recent critical/HIGH CVE
- Contact & escalation path for out-of-band / 0-day disclosure

Hi Marta —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide everything requested. High-level summary below and I attached the detailed artifacts: redwood_vm_policy_v2.pdf, scan-summary-202703.csv, cve-closure-log-202703.zip.

Scan cadence and tooling
- Internal automated full environment scan: monthly (first weekend of each month) using internal agent + cloud image scanning.
- Continuous critical-only checks: daily (signature/IOCs + targeted SCA) for high/critical classes.
- Third-party/independent scan: quarterly external penetration scan and annual CAIQ/SIG assessments.

CVE remediation SLAs (standard operating commitment)
- Critical: 7 calendar days (apply emergency mitigation + patch; if patch unavailable, documented mitigations and compensating controls)
- High: 30 calendar days
- Medium: 90 calendar days
- Low: tracked in backlog; next quarterly maintenance window

Exception & escalation process
- Exceptions require documented risk acceptance by Product Security and the owning team lead; for Critical CVEs an on-call security engineer is paged and a post-mortem is opened within 72 hours.

Evidence provided
- scan-summary-202703.csv: aggregated findings for Mar 2027 (contains severity, host, CVE id, status)
- cve-closure-log-202703.zip: redacted closure artifacts (ticket links, patch commits, mitigation notes)
- redwood_vm_policy_v2.pdf: policy + SLA matrix + escalation contacts

Owner & escalation
- Primary owner: Marcus Lin, Director, Platform Security (marcus_lin@redwood.com)
- Secondary: Laura Bennett, Head of Customer Security (laura_bennett@redwood.com)
- Out-of-band disclosure: security@redwood.com (triaged to on-call via PagerDuty)

Next steps
- Please confirm if the SLA matrix above meets FinServe's bar. If so, we can include this as an appendix to the SIG packet and sign a one-page acknowledgment. Happy to hop on a quick call if you prefer.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
